chunks: They said: "We have been sent to a wicked people."
ai.seo_question: Who were the messengers sent to the wicked people in Surah Ad-Dhariyat?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Adh-Dhariyat, this verse underscores the divine commission of messengers to 'Qawm Mujrimin' (a sinful people), a recurring motif in Quranic narrative that highlights the persistence of prophetic duty despite societal corruption. Shia exegesis often links this to the broader theme of divine justice, where the messengers' declaration serves as a precursor to the inevitable punishment for those who reject the truth, reinforcing the concept of 'Adl' (justice) in the cosmic order.
